meta.title: Signoffly: know if your app is ready to ship
meta.description: Paste a GitHub repo and get one plain-language report on security, testing, code quality and legal risk before you launch.
meta.pricing: Scan a few times a day for free. Unlock every finding and fix prompt for one repository with a project pass. No subscription.
meta.privacy: What Signoffly collects when you scan a repository, why, how long it is kept and how to delete it.
meta.terms: The terms for using Signoffly, including what a scan report is and what it is not.
meta.og.alt: Signoffly: know if your app is ready to ship. A signed off stamp.
repo.label: Public GitHub repository
repo.invalid: Paste a GitHub link, like github.com/name/repo
hero.sub: Paste a GitHub link. Get one plain-language report on security, testing, code quality and legal risk.
how.1.title: Paste
how.1.body: Drop in a public GitHub link. There is nothing to install and nothing to configure.
how.2.title: Scan
how.2.body: Proven open-source scanners read your code and dependencies. Your app is never run.
how.3.title: Sign off
how.3.body: Get one report ranked by what could hurt you first, with a fix prompt for every issue.
checks.lede: Most scanners stop at security. Signoffly also looks at the parts that sink launches quietly: missing tests, messy code and privacy rules.
checks.legal.title: Legal and privacy
checks.legal.body: Region-aware checks for wherever you launch, including Indonesia and Southeast Asia.
checks.legal.note: Findings to review with a professional. Not legal advice.
checks.security.title: Security
checks.security.body: The mistakes AI assistants repeat, found before a stranger finds them.
checks.security.1: Secret keys committed to the repo
checks.testing.title: Testing
checks.testing.body: Does the code that matters have tests? Payments, sign-in and anything that changes data are checked first.
checks.quality.title: Code quality
checks.quality.body: Copied code, very long files and loose typing, explained without jargon.
pricing.lede: No subscription to forget about. Scan a few times a day for free, and unlock everything for one repository when you need the full picture.
pricing.free.title: Free
pricing.free.3: Every finding with its title and location
pricing.free.4: Full detail on the two most important findings
pricing.pass.title: Project pass
pricing.pass.2: Every explanation and fix prompt unlocked
pricing.pass.3: Legal checks for the regions you pick
pricing.closed: Payments are not open yet. Check back soon.
faq.1.a: No. Legal findings are automated flags for you to review, ideally with a lawyer. They tell you where to look, not what the law requires of you.
faq.2.a: No. It reads your repository as text and never starts your app, so nothing of yours executes on our side.
faq.3.a: Public GitHub repositories for now. Private repos and live site checks come later.
faq.4.q: How is this different from a security scanner?
faq.4.a: Security scanners stop at security. Signoffly also checks privacy rules by region, explains everything in plain language, and writes a fix prompt for every finding.
footer.fine: Signoffly reports are automated findings, not legal advice or a security guarantee.
footer.disclaimer: Automated findings. Review anything legal with a professional.

report.incomplete.body: A report with a gap cannot be signed off. Run the scan again, or check the list below.
report.locked.title: Details are part of a project pass
report.locked.body: You can see what is wrong and where. The explanation and the fix prompt unlock with a pass for this repository.
report.lockedBanner: {count} findings show only a title and a location. A project pass unlocks them all.
report.lockedBanner.one: 1 finding shows only a title and a location. A project pass unlocks it.
